about_the_game:
The clock is ticking. Reality is crumbling. You’re being hunted down. Can you survive the climb?

Nah.

Tick-tock. Enemies are closing in. The further you climb, the more challenging it becomes. Every second counts.

  • Precision Movement

    Blink-dash through the chaos, ground-pound into your foes, and chain wall-runs like a parkour master—master the climb, or plummet to your doom.

  • Enemies & Traps Around Every Corner

    Spikes bursting from the floor, fire-breathing monsters, and gravity itself are all out to stop you.

  • Tactical Gear

    Collect one-time-use equipment as you climb—but beware, carrying too much will weigh you down.

  • Strategic Upgrades

    Build your loadout with powerful upgrades, but choose wisely—your slots are limited. Level them dynamically as you climb, adapting to every challenge.

  • Roguelike Challenge

    The climb never gets easier, only you get better. No excuses. No mercy.

You still think you've got what it takes? We'll see about that.

Gobbos might seem harmless—but don’t let your guard down. When lightning rods black out your vision and a swarm of man-eating cave worms surround you on all sides, landing your jumps on a Gobbo's cap will make your palms sweat.

You will find checkpoints along the way. They're one-time-use only, though. And yes, there’s a grapplehook. Because grapplehooks make everything better.

Equip Seals to unlock powerful abilities—but there’s a catch. Each level has a PWR limit, so choosing the right Seals is key.

Crystals let you boost Seal power during your climb, but upgrades happen at random. Will you gamble on a full loadout or focus on a few to guarantee the boost? The choice is yours—use your noggin or trust your luck.

Still here? Good—you’re tough enough for the advanced movement controls. Wall-runs, blink-dashes, ground-pounds, and jump-combos are just the beginning.

The deeper you explore the controls, the more you’ll uncover. Use blink-dashes to phase through obstacles, sprint to extend combos, or queue a dash for later with precision timing. Master the climb, and the climb will reward you.

Only the fastest, sharpest, and most precise climbers will rise above the rest. Will you be counted among their number?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Vega 3
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: You've only got a short time to climb. An army of enemies and traps are waiting to stop you. Manage your equipment, hone your build, and master your platforming techniques to climb higher than anyone before you.You think you've got what it takes? I don't think so.
